title: Remediate missing trace spans and aggregate ingress metrics after Console outage
creator: Maya Patel
description: Summary: During the 2026-02-27 Console outage we observed a blind spot: several ingress and queue-pressure signals were missing from our tenant-level dashboards and a subset of traces for the critical request path were not sampled or were dropped by the ingestion pipeline. This made it difficult to correlate tenant traffic spikes with a saturation event in the routing layer and delayed mitigation. The root causes are: (1) metric rollup configuration excluded short-lived internal queues from the aggregate ingestion pipeline, (2) sampling/cliff behaviour in the tracing agent dropped spans when request latencies exceeded 2s, and (3) multiple dashboards used averaged metrics and silently masked tail latency/p95 regressions.
incident_summary: On 2026-02-27 at ~09:42 UTC a tenant-facing latency spike degraded Console request success rates. On-call diagnosed increased queue depth in the ingress router but dashboards showed no queue depth metric for that router at tenant granularity. Traces for the affected requests were sparse and lacked correlation IDs, preventing end-to-end latency attribution. Pager triggered at 09:50; mitigation (fallback routing + scale-up) completed by 10:10 but full RCA required follow-up to restore observability coverage.
root_cause: 1) Rollup rules in the metrics aggregator excluded internal short-lived queues from tenant rollups, so per-tenant queue_depth metric was absent. 2) Tracing agent has a single global sampling threshold that drops spans when downstream latency spikes; this produced trace loss under saturation. 3) Dashboard widgets were configured with "avg" aggregation and 1m granularity, hiding p95 and tail events. 4) Correlation-id propagation had a regression in a recent PR which removed a header in the router -> worker handoff for ~3% of requests.
action_items: Add per-tenant aggregate queue_depth and ingress_rate rollups to the metrics aggregator; owner: Ethan Chen; due: 2026-03-12; success criteria: tenant dashboard shows queue_depth and ingress_rate with tenant_id label and historical retention 30d.

Change tracing sampling to dynamic AdaptiveSampler for console services (retain 100% of error traces and upsample slow traces above 95th percentile); owner: Aisha Narayanan; due: 2026-03-15; success criteria: end-to-end traces available for >98% of error requests during test storm.
Patch tracing ingestion pipeline to avoid span drop on large batch flushes (PR opened); owner: Tomas Reed; due: 2026-03-10; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tracing/pull/4821.

Update critical Console dashboards: replace avg with p95/p99 for latency widgets, add queue_depth heatmap and tenant-tail-latency chart; owner: Design Ops (Leah Kim); due: 2026-03-08; dashboard url: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/console-tenant-overview.

Reinstate correlation-id header propagation in router->worker handoff and add unit test and integration test to prevent regression; owner: Ethan Chen; due: 2026-03-05; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/1298.
Add a short playbook step to the Console runbook to check 'per-tenant queue_depth' and 'trace-loss rate' before scaling decisions; owner: Oncall WG; due: 2026-03-12.

Add synthetic tenant-level ingress load test (daily smoke) that validates queue_depth and trace end-to-end coverage; owner: SRE (Priya Singh); due: 2026-03-18; success criteria: nightly smoke asserts queue_depth appears and traces are sampled.

Backfill missing historical aggregates for the last 7 days by reprocessing metric batches where possible; owner: Data Infra (Ben Walker); due: 2026-03-14; note: best-effort, limited by raw retention window.
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Initial ticket created after postmortem meeting. Assigned to Ethan for metric rollups and to Aisha for tracing sampling changes.
2026-03-03: Correlation-id regression reproduced locally; quickfix branch created and PR opened (router#1298). QA running integration tests.
2026-03-05: Router PR merged and deployed to staging. Integration test shows correlation-id present in 100% of flows. Will monitor canary next deploy.
2026-03-06: Tracing ingestion PR opened by Tomas (tracing#4821) addressing batch flush behavior. Needs perf validation under synthetic storm.
2026-03-07: Dashboard update mockups reviewed by PM and Design Ops. Leah to implement widgets and iterate on layout for tenant heatmap.
2026-03-08: Metrics aggregator change requires a schema migration; Ben scheduling low-risk migration window. Estimate for migration 2 hours with rollback plan.
2026-03-09: Oncall WG drafted runbook addition; pending approval from SRE leads. Nightly smoke test prototype created and passing basic checks on staging.
comments: Maya Patel (creator) - 2026-03-01: Context from the postmortem — we lost visibility because of a combination of config omissions and a sampling cliff. This ticket tracks the observability remediation scoped to Console tenant-level signals.
Ethan Chen (assignee) - 2026-03-02: Plan to add two new rollups (queue_depth_per_tenant and ingress_rate_per_tenant). Will coordinate with Data Infra to ensure rollup compute cost is acceptable.

Aisha Narayanan - 2026-03-04: I tested AdaptiveSampler in staging with synthetic slow-tails; it retains error traces and upsamples tail traces as expected. Need to validate memory/ingest cost before rollout to prod.
Ben Walker - 2026-03-06: Data Infra notes: backfilling 7 days possible but requires throttled reprocessing to avoid inflight load spikes. I'll run backfill in a canary tenant first.
Leah Kim - 2026-03-07: Dashboards updated in draft. Feedback: make tenant heatmap color scale consistent with existing consoles and add a tooltip showing exact queue depth percentiles.
Priya Singh - 2026-03-08: SRE smoke harness added. We'll run a 30-minute high-traffic scenario nightly for 7 days to validate metrics and trace retention.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant queue_depth and ingress_rate appear in Console tenant overview and can be sliced by tenant_id for the last 30 days.
Traces for error and slow requests are retained and visible end-to-end for >98% of error requests during synthetic storm tests.
Dashboards show p95/p99 and heatmap widgets for queue_depth; alerts updated to use p95 thresholds rather than average.
Correlation-id propagation fixed and covered by integration tests and CI; no regression in next 3 deploys.
Runbook updated and nightly smoke tests passing for 7 consecutive runs.
